title: TestCaseHeader
description: The header of a test case written from templates/test-case.md (test-case@1).

id.description: The case's id in the test tool or GitLab once created; null until then.

case.description: Its number in the work item, TC-<n>, unique there; it names the case until it has an id.

parent.description: The requirement the case belongs to.

title.description: What it proves, as a statement of the behaviour: 'A customer with no preference says so'.

status.description: draft until reviewed; approved by the BA and the tester; created in the test tool; retired when it no longer applies.

level.description: Where it runs: one component on its own, one contract between two, two or more together, the whole system through its interface, or a user's journey across it.

type.description: What quality it checks; data is the data itself: completeness, mapping, lineage.

path.description: The criterion's main path, another valid one (none, empty, a different branch), or a failure.

technique.description: How the case was derived from its criteria.

priority.description: What a failure would cost: high blocks the requirement's purpose or loses or misstates data; medium degrades it with a workaround; low is cosmetic.

story.description: The story's file in the BA repo, pinned to a commit in a git checkout.

criteria.description: The story's acceptance criteria the case proves, by id.

verifies.description: The criteria it proves, by story.

versions.description: The versions it was written against, by name: the model, each API. A newer one sends it back to draft.

automation.description: Run by hand, worth automating, or automated.

automated_by.description: The automated test that runs it, by its path and name in its repo; null until there is one.
